Game Overview

At its heart, Hard Working Man is a adventure game about start your adventure with just a field and your willpower. Harvest nature's bounty, trade at the bazaar, and cultivate your farm. Construct greenhouses, rebuild a car, and conquer the land. Embrace the cycle of survival and growth in this immersive journey of farming and exploration.
